arabic text: KAR CHUKE SHABBIR JAB KHANJAR TALE SAJDA ADA
english translation text: AFTER IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) PROSTRATED FOR THE LAST TIME, WITH HIS NECK UNDER THE DAGGER

arabic text: KAR CHUKE SHABBIR JAB KHANJAR TALE SAJDA ADA\nHOGAYI PARDEYS MEIN KULSOOM O ZAINAB BE RIDA
english translation text: AFTER IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) PROSTRATED FOR THE LAST TIME, WITH HIS NECK UNDER THE DAGGER,\nZAINAB AND KULSOOM’S VEILS WERE SNATCHED AWAY IN THE DESERT OF KARBALA,

arabic text: JURRAT-E-ZAINAB KA HOGA TAZKARA BHI BAAR BAAR\nJAB BHI DOWRAEYGI DUNYA DASTAN-E-KARBALA
english translation text: THE COURAGE OF ZAINAB WILL BE MENTIONED AGAIN AND AGAIN,\nWHENEVER THE TRAGEDY OF KARBALA IS NARRATED AND REMEMBERED

arabic text: JIS TARHA AGHOWSHE MAADAR MEIN SAKOON MIL JATA HAI\nNIKLI ISS ANDAAZ SE BARCHI KE AKBAR SOGEYA
english translation text: THE WAY A CHILD FINDS PEACE IN HIS MOTHER’S LAP,\nAKBAR BREATHED HIS LAST AND SLEPT WHEN THE SPEAR WAS REMOVED FROM HIS CHEST

arabic text: DHOONDTI HEY RAAT BHAR PEHLOO ME ASGHAR KO RUBAAB\nGUNJTI HEY HAR LAMHE ASGHAR KE ROWNEY KI SADA
english translation text: RUBAB SEARCHES FOR ASGHAR THE WHOLE NIGHT LONG,\nSHE CAN HEAR HIS CRIES ECHOING IN HER EARS EVERY MOMENT

arabic text: AKHRI AYAAM TAK AKBAR RAHOON GI MUNTAZAR\nDEKH KAR NAKSHE KADAM KARTI RAHI SUGHRA DUA
english translation text: EVEN TILL MY LAST DAYS, I WILL KEEP WAITING FOR YOU O AKBAR,\nSUGHRA KEPT PRAYING AS SHE LOOKED AT HIS FOOTPRINTS
